2026-10-22. Read-only review of the new packet README and reviews/root-integration-review.md against the independent low-precision proof. No packet files changed.

PASS; no concrete mathematical correction required.

The generalization to supplied f,g of degree at most two is valid: the denominator Newton strip is [sj,sj+2p], and one U insertion changes the upper endpoint to sj+2(p−1)+L. Neither argument requires the displayed squared-base coefficients. Arbitrary f,g need not be cyclic units for the norm construction; the text correctly imposes an extra unit condition only for trace division.

The precision-dependent bound matches the independent proof: full products of already-truncated inputs through z-degree2q, radix2q+1, safe interpolation exponent span, post-recovery truncation, and the h=1 case are all explicit. The stated soft(h+L) bit bound charges log N and shift metadata and uses ring-valid fast multiplication, monic division and unit scalar inverses. It does not claim the schoolbook Python reference realizes that asymptotic bound.

The packet does not conflate fixed supplied U with varying native modulations. Its remaining affine direction/phase contraction is explicitly unpaid, and it retains the ell_j/long-seed/same-leaf integration requirements. Direct scalar norm/endpoint/q-Newton representations are correctly scoped as original-source operations without a new query bound. Whole-local equality and relative-conjugate caveats are retained.

The full-controller conclusion agrees with the authoritative all-semiprime paid setup: no new public-preparation gap or QRH premise is invented for bounded canonical leaves, while executable/formal integration and a full bit ledger remain distinct obligations. No whole-query or sixth-rate theorem is claimed.
